summary: PR-1655 changes Underwriting.decide, the code covered by CRD-1, so that eligible decisions carry a POLICY_SATISFIED reason. This is a behavioural change, so under LAP-1 the ledger's exhaustive Rocq proof for CRD-1 (ACR-0406, commit d30b2ad) lapses, despite the description's claim that existing evidence is linked. The only fresh evidence is a passing grid-based control test, which is weaker than a proof over the rationals. Ticket, independent approval, approval coverage and the CI run on head are in order. Security review, control-owner approval, emergency post-implementation review and exceptions do not apply to this change. Acceptance should wait for re-proof of CRD-1 against the head commit or an equivalent exhaustive record.
